details.wrappers: memory_object_iopl_request validates flags/named-entry rights/range/type before object reference and lower vm_object request. Early errors do not initialize UPL output. Copyout requires read right;non-copyout requires read+write and insufficient named-entry rights returns InvalidRight,not universal raw ProtectionFailure2. vm_map_create_upl similarly has early errors without output writes,then original map/object/recursive branches and reference balancing.
details.lower: vm_object_iopl_request early flag/address errors return before creating UPL. Later creates local UPL and publishes *upl_ptr before all page work succeeds. Its return_err unwinds original processed/deferred page wiring/activity/locks,then upl_destroy(local),finishes work context and returns error. It does not set caller outputnull afterward. Failed output can therefore be untouched or refer to destroyed local object;not a live owner to abort again.
details.caller: wireVirtual checks lower error before reading/appending current block and jumps to saved-list abort. This matches not dereferencing or double-cleaning failed current output. Saved successful blocks remain separate from locally destroyed failed request. Source current-local-not-explicitly-aborted is not a proven leak;no33rd blind abort/deallocate/null guard.
